title: A Meeting
subtitle: A MEETING
lines: One often yearns for the past,
To bask in the brilliance of one’s progenitors.
To know the pair as peer,
To know family as if fellow,
To enjoy their unique labours as if spectator in place of prize.
One chance to meld the minute,
To sculpt the second and soar,
Reaching heights unseen by kin and creeping ever closer.
To the day when deeds redeem,
When the thoughts be more than mental,
Yearning for a time when meeting makers is no fiction.

title: Accursed
subtitle: ACCURSED
lines: This foul demeanour is but a paste,
Clinging to pores like paint does canvas,
This foul retriever doth serenade dames,
Dorian depths in the mind of this heathen.
Unleashing foul beasts whom protest love and growth,
Their mother’s pearl tears all that satiates foul woes.
It would paint the ports red,
Soul defects pass porous palisades due to pleasure,

title: An Ode to a Sister Without “Sanguinity”
subtitle: AN ODE TO A SISTER WITHOUT “SANGUINITY”
lines: While my faith has been tested, withered and wailed,
I still pray for your heart, liver and tail,
Of no blood but our kinship is holy and frail,
Cells from mine do differ, for that I have failed.
For how may I claim: divinity or fame,
Yet have no new power to shape your red frames,
With tears in the eyes and hands clenched to fire,
I whisper to gods who may bless you entire.
Still pray to lords to stem the sound.
With tears in eyes my heart doth speak,
Don’t take my sister, do take me,
Sisyphus boulder: my burden to bear
Let her see skies, let me see stairs.
Burden of proof that my life did prove fixed,
Let blood in her flow like this river, this Styx.

title: Beauty
subtitle: BEAUTY
lines: The process bears burns yet the scars seem sweet.
This space here is sacred, this mind is serene.
Let it pass and behind it is wealth, golden fruit.
Soon elated as cravings are answered, by you.

title: Blame
subtitle: BLAME
lines: When their actions twist a knife,
Into my mind and wrench it out,
Erased from sight, sense and sign,

title: Blinded
subtitle: BLINDED
lines: I delegate prior memories to the pyre and pike,
Kill carnal desires with brimstone and like,
Yield space for new spires of golden delight,
Don’t remember the babe, before you, mon cœur.

title: Blink
subtitle: BLINK
lines: whom twisted his faith for the gold,
Ended the life of a soul,

title: Brit
subtitle: BRIT
lines: The horror of words unsaid by my hosts.
Unlike what was learned when elders weren’t grown.
At the feet of these fulcrums,
Whose wisdom has birthed: a prince for the age.
Of father’s mum’s tongue: I’m removed from my saints.

title: Chaser
subtitle: CHASER
lines: Heard fragments, figments or prose in between,
Of a figure divine: a sanctioned being,
That holds sway on the dreary,
For my god seems far stronger,
Or maybe it’s I with no will to stay free,
Eyes open forced shut by my god of forced dreams,
Eyes open lacked luck to see creatures from fables.
To glimpse gods in their vibrance.

title: Choose
subtitle: CHOOSE
lines: A life of pain or bliss,
The best whom boast, don’t suffer,
It dulls the nerves in time,
Those used to pain be clustered,
It feeds and fuels their fame.
Yet they would tell the peaceful,

title: Constituents
subtitle: CONSTITUENTS
lines: Wading through imagined deluge on the way.
To pave my own way in the world and stay.
The lectures held sway on the minds of those heathens,
The term here defines those without intellectual fervour.
The masses were lost once her speech hit their sections,
While one was entranced by the view from her world.
My passions did pour into abject verses.
My way was with words and my talent was stirring.
Bring pustules of pleasure to forefronts of seers.
Cast shadows of saints through nouns from the soul.

title: Corrections
subtitle: CORRECTIONS
lines: Whose reasoning led liars, to sell me dreams and hopes.
Or did they too fall flat,
For the tales from wayward does,
Words wilted, corrupted, now falsehoods in my home.
On those that see it blindly.
To lift and leave one plunder,

title: Cradle
subtitle: CRADLE
lines: A sought and seldom seen scene of serenity.
The purest picture pondered upon by the mind of the prince on their pyre.
The clearest crease of clarity on a canvas covered in crud.
Reaching their twilight still waiting for the sight.
Too talented a day to pass by,
Its date set in stone by starry-eyed angels.

title: Critique
subtitle: CRITIQUE
lines: Harsh on myself i admit i have been,
For if I am the harshest, no pain is received,
No love lost or blighted, just smiles unseen,
Some tears, in the silence, I fear for me.

title: Cyrus
subtitle: CYRUS
lines: As greatness will still end with the end.

title: December
subtitle: DECEMBER
lines: Decembrists held session and deemed their cause worthy,
Last chance to instil in the masses: a mode,
Of violent resistance and silent obsession,
With lessons on seeing, the self and the soul.
Post-childhood, now grown one must yield to the yearning,
To know one’s self, one’s essence, one’s whole,
To choose one’s actions, not slaves one’s ghosts.
While ideals stem from peace – violence vilifies votes,
Hold the facts to the frow,
From their deaths bore a code: last month signals revealing.

title: Doomed One
subtitle: DOOMED ONE
lines: So bright one thought heavens hugged the frame,
Embracing folk and freeing souls the burn was bright and named,
Heart held high once heaved from the chest,
Blistered and battered near frayed to the bone,
The golden one fell to the flames entire.
The king couldn’t keep such a prince in his home.
Beat odds and partied in glory,

title: Dormant
subtitle: DORMANT
lines: I lose track of the dew and desires.
For I be mere flesh chasing half-spawn of angels,
Monsters or mages, flesh lost in the fire.
The pure burns bright like the heart of the phoenix,
Reborn as a hunter, paving his way.
In the footsteps of giants, my crudeness is tamed,
Blood dormant and waiting to meet Angel ways.

title: Dower
subtitle: DOWER
lines: Which warlock dare speak of wrongs owed,
Whom wages war with worldly weapons,
To retort on claims so keenly,
As if to hold some semblance of a say.
Yours was lost, too long ago to tear,
Mine is lost, still whispers in ear,
So how can one accost, while I don the black,
Is it shame that you lack?

title: Dream
subtitle: DREAM
lines: For the battle has started, swords clash,
Armour rattles, attacked by rude scores,
Of the splatters, the blood, seeps in pores.
Cracks and the screams with their crazed unseen,
Crests of esteemed now are bloodied, reamed,
Crude is the dream where in death, is them.

title: Dunes
subtitle: DUNES
lines: Waves of white and dunes of yellow,
Seas of blue uprooted and tilted,
Rods of mud topped by greens,
Different fir to what I’ve seen,
Different worlds yet here I be,
A second home for a lonely being.

title: Experiment
subtitle: EXPERIMENT
lines: The den is deep and dark,
There are heaps, there are signs, saw some stars.
The mess is sprawled and large,
Saw them crawl, small lil minds, and their scars.
Newer fears, now we find, woes from Mars.

title: Fauna
subtitle: FAUNA
lines: Fills my floor with feelings of flirtation and fauna.
The breath of the birds: alive,
One hears love conveyed in quartets,
The life unlike one’s own is rife with pleasure, pain and place.
The field of fae and spirit souls whom hover higher hearths.
The end of life is worth it:
This scene, serene and flirting with my essence: it be home.

title: Fence
subtitle: FENCE
lines: With no lightning, to fear or tear asunder.
In a past life, would take a soul down under.
Blades see these and laugh: as one laughs at the child.
Whom spits words of war yet has hands yet undefiled.
In a past life: tears and bloody plunder.

title: Flow
subtitle: FLOW
lines: That breath upon which a million souls sermons rest,
Praying for your perfection or vilifying your visage,
That breath gives you life, amidst dead hopes and sorrows,
Emotions murdered by the task at hand.
Feeling the burns of pre-destined bliss bathing.
Body’s been poised for the prison or worse.
Build jails of jarred jargon thrown at useless readers,
Decorum through face, disdain dirts the silence,
Hearts lost if this moment proves more than you’d like.

title: Foreign
subtitle: FOREIGN
lines: How ajar my own tongue sounds in a land unlike my own,
Or perhaps by thine similars, as I claim not my blot of birth, instead my blood and belch.
For I scream in a tongue unlike my mother, yet still am understood.
I scream in modes unlike my father, yet still am comforted.
How they must have felt, I feel now,

title: Ghosts
subtitle: GHOSTS
lines: hese macabre death dealings haunt hosts of high spectres,
Painting the air with relentless woes.
Those unscarred mesh feelings of desire with the worst.
This facade fools heathens yet undoes the work so far.
The spirits clutch on your soul.

title: Glass
subtitle: GLASS
lines: Pristine, prudent and poorer than most,
Makes for souls enriched with the prose from their ghosts.
Hear torment and torrent all wrenched into modes,
This pauper writes print into parchment for foes.
This scripture opposed: yields cacophonies, choirs.
The pen kisses page to delight of the sirens.
As moody and bleak as the villain of violence.
Holds meeting with speak on the state of the soul.
Daunting of hosts to be captured in prose.

title: Green (from Source to Sea)
subtitle: GREEN (FROM SOURCE TO SEA)
lines: Or at least, supposed to be,
As I stare into the darkness,
The heavens spilled water in sync,

title: Grin
subtitle: GRIN
lines: That grin, hated with all my heart,
Precedes code switches and pockets full of promises: scarred.
Tug the strings and disappear in fear.
For he knows the wrath upon him,
And turns the love to leads:
When they lie through lines of white,
No light-lord would aid their truth,
So distant from the scene yet they hold sway on stars that move,
To distant distant planes in search of paradise and plans,
Astray from corrupt cored hands whom pray yet prey on pauper fans.
Will my land be whole again,
Or did the theft turn it blue.
Will my people learn to lend,
And pay their debts in full.
Will my people learn to love,
Not obey and beat their small.
Will my people learn to make,

title: Growth
subtitle: GROWTH
lines: The young sprout hit the ground running,
Painting the air nearby with prose,
The poet or plant both describing the phenom,
Whom grew into love seldom sought by the folk,

title: Heartbreak
subtitle: HEARTBREAK
lines: How does one start again at fifty,
How does one find paths unsoiled.
Had love and lust intertwined, or so,
I thought, thought wrong, was wronged, now cold.
How does one find a job for those,
Less able in body yet sharp in soul,
Or soon to be sharp, right now its shattered;
Smelt new satin sheets due to linen’s new master,
Mean. heard from the cloth, the entire façade,
Through the scented airs one heard grinning and laughter,
Champagne or the wine, both did swim in the sheets.
The old ones, forgotten, left lying in heat.
How does one start again at fifty,
Heard cries from faux hearts ‘tween the two whom belayed,
Betrayal and the shock that my mind worked in phase.
Lie crumbled so quickly I deemed it unseen.
How does one start again at fifty,
The edge of one’s heart now be facing the fire,
Explaining to peers why the ring has no sire,
Explaining to youth that one’s life’s never safe.

title: Heathen Adornment
subtitle: HEATHEN ADORNMENT
lines: Crammed in the iris of one small heathen,
Day, when my feelings laid bare to Him: judged.

title: Higher Pyres
subtitle: HIGHER PYRES
lines: Decidedly darker when spawned by host’s able.
Dutifully scraping the earth of its muse.

title: Immortum
subtitle: IMMORTUM
lines: Or preachers divine fine wisdoms in frames,
Predict denizens of ruin, and riches from rage,
Where forth lies reason, or constituent agents,
Whomst rationales be dead or derelict till waking,
Late learners bled dry to indulge warlock wonder,
Their sequel arrives, teeth stinging the night.

title: Inquisition
subtitle: INQUISITION
lines: I first glimpsed a miracle when I was young,
Am young still but was younger then,
The perspective differs, my youth as young as now,
In the eyes of a preacher, whose years have fled and cowled.
Back to the miracle, that spectre I did glimpse upon that night,
Laid eyes of mine on sights divine and leapt to learn its tricks.
How the shape has form or vice-versa, I was just a kid,
Sentence structure left at wayside while my brain indulged in trysts.
Flirted with the ghost, a beauty in a life removed from this,
Yet the fascination gripped by soul and left my life a bliss,
A weird, virulent strain of wonder latched itself to membranes since,
Sometimes I glimpse its mode, even now, so far removed from it.

title: Integrals
subtitle: INTEGRALS
lines: The edge, the limit of the sum of one’s devices,
Used in tandem to shock the soul.
The silent onus of the destitute poet,
Lending credence to claims of uncaptured woes.
Meaning missed and words whispered as opposed to loud whisks.
Now lost to the binary faults that make up the brain.
The edge, the path on which thoughts don’t return,
Used as the point on which memories blur.
The silent soldier, whom writes for the world,
Lends credence to notions that prose, does end.

title: Intrusion
subtitle: INTRUSION
lines: *The home is a home until it isn’t,*
Etched in the brain like malignant cankers,
This suffering in soul doesn’t yield or wither,
The pain felt too deep to be physical or whole.
Just sore, and grey, and scarring its soldiers,
This war once waged to reclaim a hearth,
Should one say when it happened,
Or so suspects when it changed,
That night, on that weekend, when the world seemed unruly,
Bathing in bliss and fighting fear’s folds.
*The home is a home if you fight off invaders,*
Yet the stench lingers clean, glued to walls and dulled papers,

title: It
subtitle: IT
lines: Be not afraid despite destined disaster,
For I am the prison of your pained self sleep.
This action of yours forced a heat for your furnace,
No fuel as myth-makers do not need such sway.
Once did save one from lannes,

title: January
subtitle: JANUARY
lines: Formations of fragments from previous years,
The mind still a mire of crystal tears.
Small difference ‘tween prose: one signals renewal,
Golden streaks on the face of this lord in lieu.
Wealth and fame couldn’t fill this moat,
As new as a newt: one must re-earn your vote.

title: Knight (I)
subtitle: KNIGHT (I)
lines: Put your demons on the board,
Mine own would kill yours crude.
For my mind is made of mystic horrors,
This pen dumbs down the news,
This meagre mage of crueler sorrows,
Writes prose for you: the muse

title: Knight
subtitle: KNIGHT
lines: In the steps of a giants. One craves,
A new token of praise, and a taste,
For some power with, sainthood in tow.
Crept forward slaying, the helpless saved,
By his foe: knight of the scared, made haste,
Crushed the foul, crueler men; slew the slow.

title: Loki
subtitle: LOKI
lines: The lie does now lie on the sermons of woe.
Yet the lie do be needed,
When facts fall from fragments of fear and hit folds.

title: Lone
subtitle: LONE
lines: Manifesting lives of wisdom and wonder,
I’ve learned to love the lone,

title: Lonesome
subtitle: LONESOME
lines: Again, the mire writes about the lonesome,
The miser does deem their own soul: ajar,
The maker or mystic: depends on your eyes,
A maker of mischief or mystic with fires.
Same fires that bleed onto oil-ridden frames,
Describing the words as if gauche for Goya,
Derelict, dark mind of mine preaches in pyres.

title: Luna
subtitle: LUNA
lines: The dim specks of childish stars paint harsher hues on this canvas,
This critical crevice of skin and bone, assaulted by rays of starlight.
This phase, anew, aghast with violence,
Attacking the souls of the beasts born crude,
Once babes now blistered by hairs or furs,
These darlings were something, now: “some things” askew.
A few days more then repentance and bleeding,
A few days more and the smiles disappear,
A few days more and the waning is weaving,
Itself cross the face of the moon evermore.
A week left of wondrous delight at the teething,
The sounds of the “some things” would scare any moor,
The forest is creeping, alive with the motion,
Of beasts born anew, the moon lights their core.

title: Mage
subtitle: MAGE
lines: The dull rod crackled with a flux,
As the grey claimed his peripheral view.
The sharp tinge exalted the air and aether alike, heralding the maiden use of the mahogany slab
Latin or Spanish, phrases unheard whipped the wind like shards of sermon speech
Stunned whispers and stunted choirs of pain,
Are these the writings of a mage,
Fantasies in the eyes of an infant,
Futile attempts to rationalise the suffering of his silence

title: Mayhem
subtitle: MAYHEM
lines: When you shed rationales on mayhem, method and more,
Absolving the solvent for changing the mixture,
Cleansing the blood still within demon agents.
I dare not respect such authority,
I reject all that you muse.

title: Method
subtitle: METHOD
lines: Epistles and portraits fulfil in part measures,
Painting the canvas with airs of the soul,
Yet afflictions and maladies creep further inwards,
Denying delight at retrieval and throw,
The mind be the mire, the flesh merely host,
The crag fills with pain, distant darkness and woes,
Thus the etchings in silence lift moods of the folk,
Spilling hues of hot temper, shades of dead does,
Leave the auteur in pain, and profit your pleasures,
For hurt and hate, bear the best of their code,
Leave saints to be martyred, show poets no praise,
For inner violence leaves hunger and hunger, fame.

title: Mind
subtitle: MIND
lines: This itch on my mind is unnerving. Or maybe it’s the mode alone, striving for greatness yet failing with grace; dodging all failure by inviting it all. Or maybe one’s tired, of fighting, of popping pain pustules.
The journey was winding, is winding: swerving. The journey holds terror, this journey is cruel.
Unlike my own makers, my mind is alone – no love to begrudge with this burden of glory. Unlike my life taker, I’m free from it all: the wound killing kin, yet releasing my shackles.

title: Narcissus
subtitle: NARCISSUS
lines: The soul holds sway over cosmic misfortunes,
Shift the lens and view failings as lessons to loathe.
The darkness delays that onslaught of violence,
Membranes see the light and assault the brains core.
For I spent half a life, in my mind, with my vices,
Saw cosmic horrors painted with hues from my moat.
May have mixed the proportions, mistaken my throne,
King of minutiae deemed himself king of all zones.

title: Natural Order
subtitle: NATURAL ORDER
lines: To praise fauna in the corners we call crevices,
Out of sight and mind for those whistle,
As they pass by and see no green,
Colour-blind to worlds beneath their feet so full of folly;
To see flora when in saunas as,
The heat does melt the mind and make one dream of milk-blue skies;
And just below see flowers fight for light through plight and petty squabbles:
Parading their better sides for minds that fly and move their seed.
For it is my natural order,
To see this speck of dust as is and appreciate it evermore,
One smaller cog, in this space; this universe is law,
Yet still I see the speck – still call it Earth – love it for its flaws,
One sees the green, does smile and weave tapestries: odes, in awe.

title: Neptune
subtitle: NEPTUNE
lines: The soul feels the pressure and responds with a jest,
For the mind be the court where the languish is kept,
Who swapped out their hand full of grain for the gold,
Treaties on torture to claim wealth from woe.
Invading the psyche with the diamonds one chose,

title: New
subtitle: NEW
lines: Must smell sweet to the bone.

title: Occult
subtitle: OCCULT
lines: Where-forth lays reason, pain and peace.
Wherein lies patience, wisdom or fame.
Triads of life samsaric in existence,
What strings were played to place one present,

title: Ode
subtitle: ODE
lines: Proctored by a far away god,
Translate my essence through time, not space.
Give young, feeble I a chance,
Hiding hardships as I do now,
Smiling through beaten eyes as I do still,
Laughing through cracks of pain unseen.
If I should be so privileged,
To spend a single cycle with them,
I feel they’d enjoy my company,

title: Orphan
subtitle: ORPHAN
lines: I write for that child seldom seen or heard
Whom yearns for the comfort of anger or seething,
Instead given apathy no love and no feeling,
Heart petrifies, scared of the future: a cage
The orphan boy, leech whom steals small delights,
How bad must he be to be thieving gangrene gutters,
Visage did turn to stone no way to know if teeth still grow.
The orphan boy, flirting in dreams with death and dark,
Small pleasures till in waking he does realise life’s still hard,
And cruel, and violent, for others whose light’s dim,
The orphan boy feels nothing, as no one does feel for him

title: Past
subtitle: PAST
lines: Losing itself to potential, not piety.
To make different choices and burn oh so lightly.
Too quick was the frightening: path with the turn.
Still burning so brightly,  etched in his mind.

title: Paths
subtitle: PATHS
lines: Paths lay duplicitous through these eyes,
That perceive futures of self-make and horror,
But their impressions ripple through time,
And appear as butterflies of bliss.
Living inside of one’s mind for eternity.

title: Perspective
subtitle: PERSPECTIVE
lines: Those glimmers of stardust when rays catch the air,
This cluster of stalagmite and water,
This home but a mere speck to another.
That other whom looked through their glass,

title: Pierce
subtitle: PIERCE
subTheme: If pain and pleasure be joint vice-virulence,
lines: If pain and pleasure be joint vice-virulence,
I am both sick and satisfied,
If naked tethers join junctions of jubilance,
Deeper, dark leather ‘round souls leave dice
For ‘tis chance that such clamps be unbound and unwoven,
Mere chance that the fiends show the airs of their souls,
For both pain and pleasure are measured through eyes,
That see smiles but not daggers in the palms of dark

title: Pre-Raphaelite
subtitle: PRE-RAPHAELITE
lines: The remnants of dreamers, I see through their psyche,
As I wade through the sea of green pastures and like,
Elevated myself, in both mind and floor flirting,
Climbed cliffs of chartreuse to glimpse souls of prose saints.
Understanding, gained through these eyes of mine,
Now know how they wrote with such vision: such purpose,
Saw the sky laid out at my feet, saw the world.
Inspired be I, as they were: by the earth.

title: Prince
subtitle: PRINCE
lines: I forget I am my own,
I fear my mind is not highest of all.

title: Prison
subtitle: PRISON
lines: The walls are cold, spewing whispers in hatred,
Trapping the psyche ‘tween four slabs of the stone.
The silence once sacred, now sanctioned and sought:
Employed by the mental as missiles of mischief.

title: Pristine
subtitle: PRISTINE
lines: A hollowed spectre preserved to the husk,
The scent, serene like the pit of an angel,
Rendered, clean, cured of all cuts,
Its frame is redeemed by its contents and fables.
Stories of stellar, starlight and sterling,
The words of the worldly, laid plain after yearning,
This body is holy, this body brings lust.

title: Pyre
subtitle: PYRE
lines: Whom wished for a death so quick it was fleeting.
For the flames do be higher,
Whose words spew hot higher air reserved for the most:

title: Qualia
subtitle: QUALIA
lines: Is that flutter from my flame,
For that red I see is dangerous,
Yet eyes of yours see digits,
This time we share, how so?
My world does seem so fleeting,
While yours, too slow and dull.

title: Race
subtitle: RACE
lines: I see the stares and the smiles lack sync
Can’t help themselves but to feign their affection
I see the stares and I think, how dim
Must the light inside be upon their reflection
No minds of their own just a vitriol spread
To appease my people while stares wish us dead

title: Requiem for the Polymath
subtitle: REQUIEM FOR THE POLYMATH
lines: Derelict be the duplicity of the modern man,
Where the math of the market differs so from that of the world,
Where the demiurge deals in death through daemon,
No need for epistles of glory,
No need for hearts to hit pages and etch scars on their scholars,
Assertions of credence mean more now than doubts,
No questions asked, no appearance pondered,
Foul laws of the world stay hidden and harsh.
Derelict be the duty of the modern man,
Where the calling to action be unheard by perturbed,
Soul fission flicks frailty upon human husks,
Laymen meet root meaning, laymen do despair.
No need for the angels to uphold havens,
Ghosts and their stories untold by the tough,
No need for the maker or made to taste tests,
New laws do afflict ‘selves with stagnant self wars.
Assertions in darkness, no method from mad,
Mere jests and crude jabs at the wisest of warring,
Whom fight through the math, find features in filters,
That man now lays dead, man of letters, withered.

title: Role
subtitle: ROLE
lines: Orators and narcissists perform the same modes of measure,
Proclaiming themselves, the lord of the large.
One vilified, deemed the scourge of the sane,
While other is ‘pplauded as king of the same,
Both hold their parts in society well.

title: STIMULI (ce qui motive le poète)
subtitle: STIMULI (CE QUI MOTIVE LE POÈTE)
lines: Burning the fields with hot coals from the temple.
Add a blue, for the hues of harsh herald rhymes.
Place portraits in minds of the paupers, whom write.

title: Salvo
subtitle: SALVO
lines: The madness infects all the folk,
The air turning turgid and crude in its mode.
Been a while in the making,
Have no answer for dealing with mechanised crows.
Through the grey one sees green,
Beautiful: near-fiction for future folk fables.
Took the green from the grey,

title: Scar
subtitle: SCAR
lines: A moment of mischief that lead to dark dealings,
Birthed paradise of seconds: how fleeting the motion.
Joint pain-pleasure pistols did fix self-willed woes:
If all lived with no loss,

title: Serene
subtitle: SERENE
lines: Serene like the pit of an angel,
Serene like the scent of a halo,
Want to know you like we had love,
In a past life our souls were unnerving,

title: Siren
subtitle: SIREN
lines: Chasing pain of pleasure for fear of failure,
Useful only for cauldrons of nonsense and spew.
Describe your faculties and hear back your response,
Think of self-make and fear the babe,
If one’s progeny mirrored you, would love still reside.
Tempting one to run from answers,
For it’s been read here before,

title: Sleepee
subtitle: SLEEPEE
lines: That being in its terror did save me at night,
It’s talonic teeth waved and flashed fires,
Some creature beneath all I’d dreamt or believed.
Forced my eyes to the road,

title: Sleeper
subtitle: SLEEPER
lines: A whisper heard but twice in the year,
The modern man did forget his form,
For he was a maker, myth-maker: thrall,
He was a saviour for paupers whom called.
The dark of the night or the brow of the morrow,
The grimace of dawn upon nocturnal eyes,
The sleepless did see he did save them from slumber,
Where dreams scared the folk, in their caves, alone.

title: Sorrow
subtitle: SORROW
lines: Inner fragments yell harshly at sections of bliss,
Threatening to pierce through their veils as if cysts,
The edges like glass: reflective, amiss,
Skewed by the pain from the past: that mist.
The flames round the hot slab of glass till it’s shaped,
Then the sphere do be broken,
By blistering nodules of hardship at pace.

title: Starlight
subtitle: STARLIGHT
lines: The sky at night is less dark than I once thought,
Full of distant life and love,
Yet still, less dark than I once thought,
Spotted by tiny speckles of white that glisten like diamonds held to the retina,
Like spires of selenite seen from a mile away.
Tell me again, that those specks of spectres hold masses larger than ours,
That our Sun is but a child to their giant,
A David to their Goliath with no fight to win and no people to deliver.
Tell me why I should believe the words of men like I,
Who conjure myths as easily as witches do potions; warlocks do spells; helpless do screams.
If those specks of spectres do hold stardust of unfathomable scale: what am I to an ant? What is he to me, am I a black hole in its universe? A dying of the light?
One day I will peer into the verse, and reach these specks of spectres, that glimmer like ghosts of solar systems at large; crying in light, not tears: begging to be found by sentience above our own.
The specks of spectres may reveal themselves,

title: Teetotal
subtitle: TEETOTAL
lines: The truth, when told, can cut through hearts so true,
As if meaning folds from the weight of the words: crushed.
The silence so seemly, now prayed for and loved,
The truth scarred the room with an air of demeaning.
Describe the teller, the best of the folk,
Yet sat with a stare of misfortunate reason,
The demon took hold, from the bottle its feelings,
Seeped through the membranes, neurons were sold.
Tomorrow, regret, one word for it all,
Today, the pain takes a hold of the crowd,
That truth pierced the ceiling, inhibitions and woe,
Her tongue formed the motions, the sword to their souls.

title: Ten
subtitle: TEN
lines: From abode to the spire, antecedent mode.
Now here, admiring the world at one’s feet.
The seconds turned years while one’s breaths stretch for decades,
The silence once suffered; now healing the muse.
As if scraped from sweating angels,
Up here ‘bove the clouds: my soul is alone.

title: The Future Is Furnace
subtitle: THE FUTURE IS FURNACE
lines: Why is fear felt when the future be furnace,
Burning away at the praise and the ire.
This pyre is felt by my hand and one’s hurting,
The burn is a blur, in the moment, this fire.
On the night of cold dealings,
The snake round the neck be the fear of the flame,
Yet coals sear the sky through these eyes of disdain.
If no change do be gilded,
Then the cliff a false ledge,

title: The World
subtitle: THE WORLD
lines: By mythic beasts of prose whom preached,
That life left fast as thunder.

title: Travellers
subtitle: TRAVELLERS
lines: To reach lands unseen by own,
Lies told to appease: half-truths in mode.
Yet life was lived by my forebears fully,
Smiles and tears from the best of my folk,
My idols feared all the frolic follies,
The strangers who stare and whisper in boasts.
This wergild for ancestors stolen from home.

title: Twist
subtitle: TWIST
lines: To say that this world is derelict – is to say that it is devoid of meaning,
Yet to say it is devoid – is to say that it is destitute in value.
Upon which word should one’s interpretation lay,
Whose view holds the whole portrait,
When then should one select the term and apply it unequivocably to describe the dilapidation of this seldom sought world.
If it was better, good even, surely others would come,
Flock to join us in jovial jubilance and justify their emigration,
To say the universe is silent, - would be to state it holds no sound,
Yet to say it is of no sound is to say it holds no celestial bodies.

title: Two
subtitle: TWO
lines: How flawed were my eyes that perceived no fiend.
How foul be your flowers that taunt me in dreams.
How selfish for wasting prime years on your team.
Other dusk, rakish heathen, in mind: you’re deceased.

title: Under the Hood
subtitle: UNDER THE HOOD
lines: The brain bleeds in modes unseen,
Caving to crooked and crazed afflictions.
The mind melts in the mire,
Collapsed and clawing its way through the world.
The sky erupts with a roar,
Rapturous applause only heard by one.
The blood soars to the surface,
Painting the world with noise and notes.
The innards of savants and savage alike,
Removed from the conscious thought of their workings,
That inner voice speaks on its own: discerning,
Itself as a victim, damaged in dose.

title: University
subtitle: UNIVERSITY
lines: Arrival brings reason, remorse or regret,
At the end of the platform lays pleasure and pleasing,
Which way to the future, unknown by the worthy,
Used will and their wisdom to reach this new meaning.
Could wade in the water, or dive to the depths,
Drowning in liquors, or floating in feeling,
The wisdom was dealt, by beings outside reason,
The mission is keeping the brain through the wreck.
First month on the sea is the trial for the wretched.
And holds them hostage, so far from the home.
The depths once deadly, soon speak to the soul,
Three years and the victim, stands tall in the moat.
Yet now on the platform, one stares through the cold,
Sees specks of starlight reflected and rogue.
Distorted and altered, the water is weaving.
Your actions in water are left at the coast,
You step on the pier and,
Twisted and turned: not what left, the home.

title: Varifocals
subtitle: VARIFOCALS
lines: The mind of the miser would not seek higher pleasures.
For the solace breeds a want,
The writer needs pain – to elevate prose.
So one shifts the lens: dark blood-tints do no favours,
Must relearn the ways – to see the world.
The form of the fierce must change to the flawed.
Find a home in one’s idols,
For said space will bring peace for the pleasure of all.
So on dull and dark days,

title: Viscera
subtitle: VISCERA
lines: This canvas is bloodied – a positive paste.
These neurons do fire – ‘bout neurons innate.
One reflects on reflecting and confuses the codes,
How this brain sees itself is a miracle, crazed.
Ten thousand emotions held up to the fire.
How they fit In this frame,
Not even a Galen could map these runs.
One deflects on deflection yet is shocked by how stagnant,
Their body remains – echoes mind in its mode.

title: Voice of a ‘Miser’
subtitle: VOICE OF A ‘MISER’
lines: Ten years of hard labour turned turgid and tame,
As if used as a reason to render mine frayed,
Or useless, denying the context in phase.
Lost my way for a day,
Had enough of the musings ‘bout rice or the rain,
Lost my life for responding as ancestors would.
I believed that my place was on pedestals of saints.
Come to find that my role fit the quota: for fame.
I was fired the moment I signed to this state,
My fate in the fire, now this pyre lacks praise.
Unruly, fake smiles to the face,
I was fired today, never safe in this maze.

title: Voiced
subtitle: VOICED
lines: The voices fight for a place on the pedestal,
Steering the minds of the folk in the room,
Opinions are barrelled and fired at chest.
Of peace: for I prosper ‘mongst dismal fiends.
The liege: for I holster rebuttals for free.
And their eyes start to dare,

title: Warmth
subtitle: WARMTH
lines: That coloured one’s vision, clouding one’s far-sight.
Took years of mistakes to perceive it whole.
Decays: its flesh now exposed to the crows,
At the doorstep of I: once kid – now grown.
That place soon a tale of growth and grieving.
That place once solvent now solves all one’s woes.

title: Waves
subtitle: WAVES
lines: Painting the sea with its glory and glutton,
Am I therefore, Ulysses or some miser?
For wasting away on this wooden mistake.
Used monster to mean one’s owns passions and pyres.

title: Wergild
subtitle: WERGILD
lines: The silence of salience lingered in slumber,
Replaced upon wake by the virile sense,
Of violence, vitriol, valiance through plunder,
Minds of the makers, met with and wrenched.

title: Whisper
subtitle: WHISPER
lines: How many whispers, till words wane in meaning,
Melding prose morbid in tone and mode.
Witch welded and slithered, from tongues of misplacing,
Truth tied in a room, locked away from the soul.
The horror soon made into satire for you,

title: Why Now
subtitle: WHY NOW
lines: Every seedling of stardust serenaded into starlight,
Every shade and hue, tint and taste,
Why now do I draw breath and fight futile thunders.

title: Yearn
subtitle: YEARN
lines: To crave another’s soul without carnal intent,
To fight for a futile farce,
Satiate this soul and strike one with serendipity.
Gift one a love of lifetimes left lost,
Let the knowledge bring forth pain,
Yet for that day paint pleasure,

title: Yearn II
subtitle: YEARN II
lines: That it will find that hope again,
Where the world is right and right makes sense,
Where the beauty in brilliance lays naked: stares,
Back at my eyes, in love, intent.
That body was holy; mind: dark and dull.
That brilliance in beauty held sway on my mould,
Now eyes wide open, see demons in dolls.
You slighted my heart, left scars on my bones.

title: “Lo”
subtitle: “LO”
lines: Do souls truly suffer in silence?
Or beg for the noise as to blame other’s mouths.
Sit silently waiting for sunlight’s calling.
For waiting and wading with whispers,
For holding themselves from the belches and bursts.
Do souls truly suffer in silence?
The wisest seem taken: they crave it the most.
